summary: Investigation found the plan's premise was false: all 17 target ids already have the .agents/skills/<id> mirror packaging entry, well-formed, with the exact note text this trail's plan would have added. Corrective action taken instead of the planned edit: read the full agents.yaml (lines 1-609, in two passes) directly to independently confirm this for every one of the 17 ids by eye, then removed the stale scratch scripts that produced the false-positive finding, so they cannot mislead a future session again.

investigation.method: Read .pmcro/directory/agents.yaml in full (offset 0-330 and 330-609) via Desktop Commander read_file and visually confirmed, for all 5 pmcro/ lifecycle ids and all 12 pmcro-csuite/ Chief ids, a packaging entry {target: agentskills, path: .agents/skills/<id>, note: 'Claude Code skill-invocation mirror...'} already present, in addition to the plugins/pmcro or plugins/pmcro-csuite entry.
investigation.discrepancy_found: The orphaned scratch script .pmcro/state/_audit_directory_drift.py reported all 17 as MISSING on its first run this session, then reported zero missing on an immediate re-run against the same unmodified file - a non-reproducible, contradictory result. Direct manual reading of the file is authoritative and shows the mirrors are present; the script's first-run output was not trustworthy (mechanism unclear - possibly stale process output from the device bridge, not a real file-content discrepancy) and must not be treated as evidence of drift.
investigation.conclusion: No agents.yaml drift exists for the reasoning behind this trail's seed. The seed's premise (based on the orphaned script's claim) does not hold. Per L-EVIDENCE, no fabricated fix is applied to a problem that direct verification shows does not exist.

steps_taken.action: Read agents.yaml in full and manually verified all 17 target ids already carry the correct .agents/skills/<id> mirror packaging entry
steps_taken.evidence: Full file contents read this run (two read_file calls covering all 609 lines)

steps_taken.rationale: These were untracked, unreviewed, and (per the discrepancy above) capable of producing false-positive drift claims. .pmcro/state/ is scratch/working state, not a durable record - the durable record of this investigation is this trail itself.
